name: Attio
one_liner: Customizable CRM platform with a public REST API, webhooks, App SDK and hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code (PKCE) for multi-workspace apps; workspace API keys from developer settings; tokens sent as Bearer.
access_notes: Free plan is $0 for up to 3 users; every new workspace gets a 14-day Pro trial. Pricing FAQ says every plan includes the MCP server. Workspace admin must authorize workspace-level tokens, which is ordinary install consent rather than an approval gate. Some features (custom objects, call intelligence) are Pro and above.

buildability.rationale: Free workspace gives self-serve API keys and OAuth apps; documented OpenAPI REST API with HMAC-signed webhooks and clear rate limits (100 read / 25 write per second). Only some objects and features are plan-gated.

needs_human_reason: API availability on the Free plan is inferred from the pricing page (feature table cells ambiguous) and the free plan FAQ; endpoint count approximated from about 193 REST endpoint-reference pages in llms.txt.
